neighbours.label: Russian ' при' and locative or circumstantial English ' at' (at work, at a loss), not 'looked at'
fire: Он живёт при монастыре уже год.
Цены росли, при этом зарплаты падали.
She learned her rights at work from the union.
Extra parts come at additional charge.
He is at risk of losing his job.
The firm sold them at a loss.
quiet: Он живёт в монастыре уже год.
